title: Goals close on the live loop: goal.close accepts the verifier receipt and the landing receipt as the verification leg
description:
Filed by session moe-next-67 for the owner (2026-09-04), sibling of the epic-8ebe6417 rows.

PRODUCT GAP, measured at main 68eb1c5d and on the live UnAI store: every goal stays EXECUTION_ENABLED forever. Three UnAI goals have accepted nodes (node-uai-core-identities and node-uai-evidence-ledger accepted 2026-09-02 with `ReviewOutputAccepted` + `VerifierReceiptRecorded`; evidence-ledger-durable-ingest accepted 2026-09-04 08:20Z) and none can close: `goal.close` (payload `["closureWitness", "goalId", "zeroAuthorityWitness"]`, daemon-command-vocabulary.ts) is served through `apps/daemon/src/goals/goal-close-prerequisite.ts` and `apps/daemon/src/goals/goal-qualification.ts:139-164` (`zeroAuthority`), whose verification leg compares FOUNDATION receipt fields (`receipt.*`) that only the seeded Foundation journey produces. A real seat's node carries `moe-verifier-receipt` + `integration.accept_output` + `moe-landing-receipt/1`, never a Foundation RECEIPTED row, so `NodeClosure.receipt` is absent and closure refuses. The control room's status strip already computes READY_TO_CLOSE ("All N acceptance criteria are verified", goal-status.ts:130-142) and Needs you offers the close when the daemon does - the daemon never does for a real goal.

FEATURE: closure over the live loop's own evidence. For each node in the goal's activated graph, the verification leg accepts EITHER the Foundation receipt (seed journey, unchanged) OR the pair {verifier receipt with proof PASSED (apps/daemon/src/orchestrator/verifier-receipt-ledger.ts), acceptance `ReviewOutputAccepted`} plus, when landing is on, a `moe-landing-receipt/1` (COMMITTED, or REFUSED with NOTHING_TO_COMMIT which is a legitimate outcome when the workspace already held the work). `NodeClosure.receipt` becomes optional; `compose`, `zeroAuthority` and `verifiedResultHolds` skip the Foundation leg when no RECEIPTED row names the node and take the live leg instead; the closure witness names which leg proved each node. The daemon OFFERS `goal.close` on `/affordances/read` once every node of the goal is accepted and every approved criterion reads VERIFIED on the coverage read (document-coverage-read.ts). UI: Needs you's existing close card (needs-you-model.ts CLOSE kind) works unchanged; the board header's stage moves READY_TO_CLOSE -> CLOSED (STAGE_WORDS "Closed") and the goals list card reads Done.

Out of scope: expansion runs; multi-node ordering (sibling row task-4423d2a4); the Foundation seed path stays byte-for-byte.
definitionOfDone: `goal.close` on a goal whose nodes carry verifier receipt (PASSED) + `ReviewOutputAccepted` + landing receipt (COMMITTED or REFUSED NOTHING_TO_COMMIT) and NO Foundation receipt commits `GoalClosed`; the closure witness names `leg: "LIVE"` per node; asserted over a REAL store driven by the production sequence (bootstrap-test-fixtures), not a fixture record.

Refusal arms asserted with code + layer: a node accepted but with no verifier receipt refuses; a node with a receipt whose proof is not PASSED refuses; an unverified criterion refuses; the existing Foundation-receipt arm and its codes are byte-identical (its test file unchanged, count line quoted).

`/affordances/read` offers `goal.close` for a real goal exactly when every node is ACCEPTED and coverage totals.verified == totals.criteria; a test shows the offer absent one acceptance earlier and present after; the offer is HUMAN-only as today (MCP-excluded roster test unchanged).

Control room: Needs you renders the close card for such a goal (needs-you.test.tsx), clicking Close commits and the goals list card reads Done and the board header stage reads Closed on the next poll (board-screen.test.tsx or goal-status.test.tsx).

Live drive: one of the UnAI goals with an accepted node is closed from the browser; the `GoalClosed` event id and the coverage read (n/n VERIFIED) quoted in a row comment; README 'Review loop' / close clause updated if it names the Foundation receipt.
Gates quoted with their count lines: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`, `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm test:e2e`.

Ids follow in the next comment.

FOUR DoD CLAUSES ARE RE-ANCHORED (grade the measured truth, not the wording):
1) "apps/daemon/src/orchestrator/verifier-receipt-ledger.ts" does not exist; the verifier receipt reader is apps/daemon/src/review/verifier-receipt-ledger.ts:85 and goal-qualification.ts ALREADY reads it (reviewClosure :95-137) - the live acceptance + verifier receipt are already checked; only the Foundation RECEIPTED-row demand (:213-216 via indexDurableReceipts) and the Foundation-derived witness refs block a real goal. Child 1 replaces that demand with the live leg + the landing rule.
2) "the daemon never offers goal.close for a real goal" is stale: affordance-planning-offers.ts:143-147 offers `goal.close` on EVERY EXECUTION_ENABLED/CLOSING goal; the human clicks and gets the refusal. DoD 3 is therefore a NARROWING of the offer (child 2), and the contract-less legacy/seed path (tests/e2e/control-room/board-chain.spec.ts:462-472 asserts the close card right after activation) stays offered as today - the gate applies only to goals with an approved Product Contract (criteria > 0).
3) "the closure witness names which leg proved each node": core's closure witness is an exact key roster (packages/core/src/goal/goal-validation.ts:27,:160), so the leg lives in the derived ref preimages and in a daemon-side `legs` field on the qualification result, never as a witness key.
4) "an unverified criterion refuses": closure qualification does not read coverage today; child 2 adds GOAL_CLOSE_CRITERIA_UNVERIFIED (the ONE new code of this row, with its 5-consumer roster backfill) checked in goal-services/goal-qualification against the coverage read's totals, and uses the same readiness for the offer gate. Child 1 adds no code: a landing refused with a code other than NOTHING_TO_COMMIT reuses GOAL_CLOSE_VERIFICATION_NOT_PASSED with a distinguishing message.
